court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Hamirpur - Matrimonial Petition No. 193 of 2021
case_name: Smt. Jyoti Vishwakarma vs Pushpendra Pratap Singh Vishwakarma
facts_of_case: Matrimonial dispute between wife and husband; wife seeks transfer of petition from Principal Judge, Family Court, Hamirpur to Principal Judge, Family Court, Banda.

legal_principles.principle: Convenience of the wife is a good ground to consider while granting a transfer in matrimonial causes.
legal_principles.held: In this regard, reference may be made to the decision of the Supreme Court in Anjali Ashok Sadhwani v. Ashok Kishinchand Sadhwani, AIR 2009 SC 1374, where it has been held that in matrimonial causes, convenience of the wife is a good ground to consider while granting a transfer.
cited_cases: Anjali Ashok Sadhwani v. Ashok Kishinchand Sadhwani, AIR 2009 SC 1374
N.C.V. Aishwarya v. A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1199

cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya v. A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1199

outcome.final_order: Transfer of Matrimonial Petition No. 193 of 2021 from Principal Judge, Family Court, Hamirpur to Principal Judge, Family Court, Banda.

use_for_drafting: advising on jurisdiction in family court matters
